definitions.explanation: Postal service that delivers faster than ordinary mail for an extra fee. Items are marked with a red line and handled ahead of regular post.

examples.japanese: {速達便|そくたつびん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{送|おく}った→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: I sent it by express mail.

examples.japanese: ⟦{急|いそ}ぐ→急ぐ：01191_isogu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で{速達便|そくたつびん}にして⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: It's urgent, so please send it as express mail.

examples.japanese: ⟦{願書|がんしょ}→願書：16223_gansho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{締|し}め{切|き}り→締め切り：04162_shimekiri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{間|ま}に{合|あ}わせる→間に合う：01142_maniau⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{追加|ついか}{料金|りょうきん}→追加料金：22313_tsuikaryoukin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}って→払う：00535_harau⟧{速達便|そくたつびん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{出|だ}した→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: To make the application deadline, I paid the extra fee and sent it by express mail.

notes:
⟦{速達|そくたつ}→速達：04393_sokutatsu⟧ (express delivery) + ⟦{便|びん}→便：28160_bin⟧ (a mail or transport service). ⟦{速達|そくたつ}→速達：04393_sokutatsu⟧ alone is used just as often; {速達便|そくたつびん} stresses that it is a particular service option.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {速達便|そくたつびん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧: to send by express mail
- {速達便|そくたつびん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to make it express mail
- {速達便|そくたつびん}⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧: the express mail fee

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{書留|かきとめ}→書留：00150_kakitome⟧: registered mail — about tracking and compensation, not speed; often combined with express
- ⟦{宅配便|たくはいびん}→宅配便：09534_takuhaibin⟧: parcel delivery service — run by private couriers, for packages rather than letters
